svg.title: Data warehouse — star schema and marts (dbt)
svg.desc: Core star schema: fct_trips with dim_date and dim_station; fct_station_status_intervals from live GBFS poller sessions. Marts aggregate the core: mart_trip_analytics, mart_station_demand, optional mart_station_availability.

text.tspan: PostgreSQL 18 · built and tested by dbt
every published trip (after quarantine); duration metrics use is_duration_valid only
a station-to-station trip counts once at each end — never add them up as trips
arrivals − departures: demand-imbalance proxy, NOT bike inventory
Chicago wall clock (no time zone); UTC observations converted to local
